claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine (blow molding machine)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a blue industrial machine consistent with a blow molding/plastic forming machine.

claims.claim: Used in production to make PET plastic bottles of different sizes
claims.evidence: No output, molds, or product samples shown to confirm bottle sizes or production use.
No power-on, cycle run, or output video provided; cabinet doors are open with no operational context.
No service record, receipt, or dealer documentation visible in the photo.
Open cabinet shows some internal components but no full inventory or mold/accessory set visible.
No nameplate, brand, or model marking is legible in the photo.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or complete a molding cycle
risks.proof: Video of machine powering on and completing a full blow-molding cycle producing a bottle

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model/specification, affecting resale and capacity value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the data/nameplate with brand, model, and capacity details

risks.risk: Missing molds, tooling, or auxiliary parts needed for production
risks.proof: Photos of all molds, hoppers, and accessory components included with the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, mold/tooling cost added separately

risks.risk: Electrical requirements (voltage/phase) unknown, may need rewiring or transformer
risks.proof: Photo of electrical rating plate or wiring panel
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming extra electrical conversion cost

risks.risk: No verified maintenance or repair history
risks.proof: Service receipts or maintenance log from the dealer
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown condition, assume near-term servicing needed

risks.proof: Photo of hour meter or production log, or manufacture date stamp

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the machine's nameplate/data plate (brand, model, voltage, capacity)
Video of the machine powered on and running a full bottle-molding cycle
Photos of all molds, tooling, and accessories included
Photo of any service/maintenance receipts or logs
Photo of electrical connection panel or rating plate
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a plastic blow molding machine, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified working condition, unknown brand, incomplete accessories) pending the listed proofs.
